workflow.description: These conditions and calculations run in the order shown. Open the code to inspect their exact rules.

workflow.description: The request meets the policy's rules. This result is not a transfer receipt.
workflow.label: Pass the policy check

functionHelp.name: set_cap
functionHelp.title: Total spending limit
functionHelp.description: Sets the total amount this policy can spend. Previous spending and the new request must fit within this limit.

functionHelp.name: cap_per_transaction
functionHelp.title: Limit per purchase
functionHelp.description: Rejects a purchase above this amount, even when money remains in the total allowance.

functionHelp.name: cap_purchase_tiers
functionHelp.title: Purchase tiers
functionHelp.description: Limits expensive purchases: the first price band allows the stated count. Each cheaper band halves the ceiling and doubles the count. No minimum purchase amount; the total cap still applies. Uses authoritative purchase history, including reservations.

functionHelp.name: usdc
functionHelp.title: USDC amount
functionHelp.description: Writes amounts in USDC: usdc("25.50")? means 25.50 USDC. Up to six decimal places, with no rounding. On Testnet this unit uses the policy's configured six-decimal test token.

functionHelp.name: percent
functionHelp.title: Percentage
functionHelp.description: Writes a percentage from 0 to 100: percent("85")? means 85%, or 8,500 basis points. Up to two decimal places, with no rounding.

functionHelp.name: amount_at_most
functionHelp.title: Compare purchase amount
functionHelp.description: Checks whether the purchase is at or below this USDC amount, including equality. This comparison does not set a spending allowance.

functionHelp.name: within_percentage_points
functionHelp.title: Compare returns
functionHelp.description: Checks whether the candidate return is no more than this many percentage points below the benchmark. Both returns use basis points. A higher return passes; 4% versus 5% passes a 1-point gap. This is an absolute gap, not a relative percent change.

functionHelp.name: allow_actions
functionHelp.title: Exact action labels
functionHelp.description: Compares the caller-supplied action field with literal strings. It does not verify an action's category or purpose; use check_preference for classification.

functionHelp.name: require_merchant
functionHelp.title: Required merchant
functionHelp.description: Allows a request only when its merchant exactly matches this value.

functionHelp.name: require_recipient
functionHelp.title: Required recipient
functionHelp.description: Allows funds to be sent only to this exact address. The executing wallet or contract verifies the destination.

functionHelp.name: confidence
functionHelp.title: Confidence interval
functionHelp.description: Reads the supplied evidence interval. Both bounds use basis points: 10,000 means 100%. Missing or invalid evidence rejects the request.

functionHelp.name: preference_evidence
functionHelp.title: Preference evidence
functionHelp.description: Reads the named trusted optional numeric evidence. Use only inside the matching preference guard.

functionHelp.name: semantic
functionHelp.title: Preference assessment
functionHelp.description: Reads an assessment of how the request fits this preference. A missing assessment prevents approval. A point score is not a calibrated confidence interval.

functionHelp.name: check_preference
functionHelp.title: Preference
functionHelp.description: Assesses this preference. Enabled approval and denial thresholds apply inclusively; all other scores ask you. Every other policy rule must still pass. The result is one preference-fit score, not calibrated confidence.

functionHelp.name: context_u64
functionHelp.title: Request value
functionHelp.description: Reads a whole-number value supplied with the request, such as an expected return in basis points. Missing or non-whole values reject the request. Supplied facts need a trustworthy source.

functionHelp.name: require_user_input
functionHelp.title: Ask for approval
functionHelp.description: Pauses for your approval. Declining rejects the request.

functionHelp.name: owner_limit
functionHelp.title: Owner-controlled limit
functionHelp.description: Declares one named native limit and its initial integer units in new(). Owner authorization controls later native account updates.

functionHelp.name: stored_limit
functionHelp.title: Read native policy storage
functionHelp.description: Reads a declared limit from verified current native account state. Missing trusted state prevents approval.

functionHelp.name: is_one_of
functionHelp.title: List membership
functionHelp.description: Checks whether the primitive string equals an entry in a bounded inline or constructor list.

functionHelp.name: fail
functionHelp.title: Reject the request
functionHelp.description: Stops evaluation and rejects the request with this explanation. No spending is authorized.

functionHelp.name: paysh::call
functionHelp.title: Paid provider call
functionHelp.description: Admits one call using authenticated run input and exact payment, swap and service-fee ceilings. True means admitted plan, not payment or delivery. The host settles through the selected native wallet and provider adapter after every policy guard passes.

functionHelp.name: allowit::execution_request_validate
functionHelp.title: Validate native request
functionHelp.description: Checks the complete request through the installed native profile. Structural validity is not spending approval.

functionHelp.name: paysh::payment_request_from_curl
functionHelp.title: Convert payment challenge
functionHelp.description: Converts an authenticated bound challenge into unsigned payment facts. None means a valid bound free response; failures remain errors.

functionHelp.name: allowit::execution_request_cap
functionHelp.title: Typed asset budget
functionHelp.description: Checks complete same-asset debit and cumulative fee bounds against an owner-authored total budget and protected prior consumption. Other assets need separate guards. The host atomically reserves the approved plan before signing.
